info.title: F-Grade Corporate AI CRM API
info.description: Universal CRM retrieval and reasoning backend for the F-Grade Corporate AI Agent. Treat the connected CRM as the source of truth and dynamically discover modules, fields, relationships, permissions, filters, date logic, aggregation, pagination, and calculations for any legitimate CRM request. Semantic concepts such as converted, conversion rate, revenue, pipeline, and top owner are business operations, not fixed CRM field names. The backend must also handle follow-up questions, corrections, comparisons, explanations, summaries, and cross-module scenarios by rebuilding from the current user intent.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Use this single tool for every legitimate CRM question and any legitimate follow-up, correction, comparison, explanation, summary, lookup, trend, funnel, conversion, ranking, or cross-module scenario. The backend must interpret the user's intent as precisely as possible before retrieval, preserving the full natural-language question and resolving the exact scope, module, metric, date basis, relationships, and outcome expected from CRM context and metadata. Conversion questions must remain natural language and be handled by the backend. Send the user's complete natural-language question unchanged in question. Use conversation_id only when the current message is a true follow-up to the same conversation. The backend owns module discovery, module selection, module-specific field validation, relationship validation, dynamic date interpretation, pagination, aggregation, ranking, conversion logic, query budgeting, retry repair, and final answer generation. For multi-module questions, the backend must execute separate module-valid retrievals and combine the results only after verifying relationships. Never construct module names, field names, owner IDs, filters, COQL, date criteria, aggregate expressions, conversion logic, or guessed relationships in Copilot Studio. Never substitute one module for another. Never send Deal fields such as Amount or Stage to Leads. Never emit a Leads field named Converted. If the backend can safely interpret the request from CRM context, it should do so without asking unnecessary clarification questions.
info.x-copilot-studio-input-policy: question is required, must contain the user's complete natural-language CRM request, and may be up to 2000 characters. Send conversation_id only when available for the same conversation. Do not transform, shorten, summarize, or reinterpret the question. Preserve the user's wording, but internally resolve the precise module, intent, metric, filters, date range, scope, and requested output from the current message and conversation context. If the current message changes the CRM module, metric, date range, scope, or requested output, the backend must rebuild the request from the current intent and discard incompatible previous fields, filters, and calculations.

post.description: Resolves record, count, aggregate, grouped, and lead-conversion questions and executes the required filtered Zoho CRM query or queries.

200.description: Complete answer and requested CRM data returned by the backend for the user's question.

400.description: Invalid question, field, date, owner, or aggregate request.

502.description: Zoho CRM configuration, authentication, or query failure.

AssistantRequest.description: Natural-language CRM question. Send the complete user request in question.

question.description: The complete natural-language CRM question provided by the user.

conversation_id.description: Optional stable conversation identifier used to resolve natural-language follow-up questions.

response.description: Complete answer and requested CRM data returned by the backend for the user's question.
Complete answer explaining why the backend could not answer the user's question.
